q: gerthardus lodewikus booysen — – — · booyzen the top of the male line — and, since the 1876 sterfkennis was read, no longer a name held up by the family tree alone. his son’s death notice names him and his wife in line 3. he still has no birth date, no death date, and no parents: the oldest open question on this site is about him.

magdelena elisabeth de beer 1754 – 1843 · booyzen wife of gerthardus lodewikus. her 1754 birth is what dates him at all — and her name, beside his, is what the 1876 notice puts on the record. that matters because a 1793 cape will names a different “jan booysen, married to the late magdalena de beer”: the pairing was never unique, and now this line’s version of it is documented.

s: c. 21 Sep 1788, Graaff-Reinet – 1 Sep 1876, district Rustenburg · Booyzen
q: petrus jacobus booysen c. 21 sep 1788, graaff-reinet – 1 sep 1876, district rustenburg · booyzen married at about seventeen; died a widower in the transvaal, eighty-eight years old, on a farm called brakfontein. his sterfkennis — no. 678, written 14 september 1876 — is the oldest document about this family that this archive has read, it names his parents, and it lists eight children. estate: nothing. “niets nagelaten. niets bekend.”

david schalk booijsen 12 dec 1806, baptised 4 jan 1807 – — · booyzen first on his father's 1876 death notice, and a major — and now with a date. his baptism of 4 january 1807 names his parents as pieter jacobus booijzen and anna maria van der merwe, which is the only document in this archive that puts anna maria in the family at all. his father was eighteen when he was born. he married adriana christina viljoen — on 3 november 1828 at cradock, a date and a place this archive did not have until wikitree was read on 13 september 2026, and from wikitree, not from a document this archive has read — and named a daughter anna maria in 1835, after his own mother. his nephew, born 1848, carries the same name — the two are told apart only by a generation.

adriana christina viljoen — – — · booyzen his wife, married at cradock on 3 november 1828—from wikitree, not from a document this archive has read—and named with him on their daughter anna maria's baptism of 13 september 1835 — a daughter called after his mother, which is how this archive knows the naming ran that way in this generation too.

anna maria booijsen of 1835 7 aug 1835, baptised 13 sep 1835 – — · booyzen daughter of david schalk booijsen and adriana christina viljoen, and named for her grandmother anna maria van der merwe — the second document in this archive to carry that name forward.
magdalena johanna booijsen — – — · booyzen second on the 1876 notice, named for her mother magdalena de beer. a niece born 1853 carries the name again.
anna eliezabet booijsen — – — · booyzen fourth on the 1876 notice.

s: 1818, district Graaff-Reinet – 25 May 1885, Vaalbank, district Lichtenburg · Booyzen
q: jan gerthardus lodewikus booijsen 1818, district graaff-reinet – 25 may 1885, vaalbank, district lichtenburg · booyzen fifth on his father’s 1876 notice, and named for the man at the top of the line. his is the estate tab mhg o/2899, which this archive had spent months attributing to his nephew of the same name born in 1855 — the transvaal probate index gives him as the deceased, aged 67, born district graaff-reinet, died 25 may 1885 at vaalbank in the district of lichtenburg. his daughter magdalena susanna maria died on the same farm in 1920, and her death notice names him. he is how this family reaches the western transvaal.

t: Magdalena Susanna Maria van den Berg
s: c. Aug 1860 – 1 May 1920, Vaalbank, district Lichtenburg · Booyzen
q: magdalena susanna maria van den berg c. aug 1860 – 1 may 1920, vaalbank, district lichtenburg · booyzen his daughter, and the first person in the western transvaal this archive can attach to the line rather than merely set beside it. her 1920 sterfkennis — estate 44420, stamped pretoria 16 august 1920 — names her parents as jan gerhardus lodewicus booyzen and magdalena susanna maria, gives her age as 59 years 9 months, and lists seven children. her son-in-law b. j. van den berg signed it.
eliezabet cornelia booijsen — – — · booyzen sixth on the 1876 notice.

s: c. 1828, Graaff-Reinet – 11 May 1908, Koedoesfontein, district Rustenburg · Booyzen
q: hendrik stefanus booijsen c. 1828, graaff-reinet – 11 may 1908, koedoesfontein, district rustenburg · booyzen seventh on the 1876 notice — and the man who signed it, four lines under his own name, beside the veldkornet. his own death notice, tab estate 14380, names his mother as elizabetha booysen, born van der merwe — which resolves this archive’s oldest “serious” contradiction, because his father’s recorded wife anna maria van der merwe died three years before he was born. a farmer, “dutch”, married twice — anna catharina johanna olivier, then charlotta elizabetha dormehl — and married last at zeerust, in the district of marico. he died in his son-in-law’s house.

elizabetha van der merwe — – — · booyzen the second wife of petrus jacobus booysen (b. 1788), and a name this archive did not have until her son’s 1908 death notice was read. the first wife, anna maria van der merwe, died before march 1825; this son was born about june 1828. two van der merwe wives, one after the other — which is why the eight children on the 1876 sterfkennis cannot all be drawn under one marriage.

s: c. Oct 1841, Graaff-Reinet – 6 Feb 1902, Driefontein, Groot Marico · Booyzen
q: charlotta elizabetha dormehl c. oct 1841, graaff-reinet – 6 feb 1902, driefontein, groot marico · booyzen his second wife, married at zeerust on 14 april 1892 when she was fifty-one and he sixty-three, and her own death notice 844 gives the rest: born graaff-reinet about october 1841, farmer's wife, father jacob dormehl and mother unknown, dead at driefontein in groot marico on 6 february 1902 aged 60 years 4 months, leaving one wagon and household furniture worth £51 8s 0d and a will. three husbands — jacob van staden, then matthys roos, then booysen — and six children, two van stadens and four rooses, not one of them a booysen. that is why the four children this archive once drew under her are not hers.
jacob dormehl — – — · booyzen named as her father on the 1902 death notice. her mother is entered unknown — the seventh parent this archive's documents fail to name.
jacob van staden — – bef. 1902 · booyzen her first husband, named on her 1902 death notice with the date of his death given as unknown. two sons, jacob alewyn and coenrad sybert.

matthys roos — – bef. 1892 · booyzen her second husband, and the reason the 1892 marriage register writes her in as charlotta elizabeth roos, geboren dormehl. four children. the date of his death is entered unknown.

ockert johannes stephanus booysen 15 sep 1852 – 16 jan 1921, klerksdorp · booyzen signed his father’s 1908 death notice as “son of the deceased” — thirty-two years after his father had signed his own father’s at brakfontein. second of the seven children on his mother’s 1891 notice, and he carries her father’s name: ocken johannes oliefier. confirmed at rustenburg on 3 april 1869, the same day as his brother petrus jacobus. he died at klerksdorp on 16 january 1921, aged 69 — a civil registration, which names no parents.

jacob alewyn van staden — – — · booyzen her elder son by her first marriage, a major by 1902. named on her death notice under a brace of his own, separated from the four roos children below — question nine asks for the children “stating separately those born of different marriages”, and her husband did as he was told.

coenrad sybert van staden — – — · booyzen her second son by jacob van staden, a major by 1902. sybert recurs in the next marriage — a johannes sybert roos — which is unusual enough to be worth noticing across two husbands.
gert johannes roos — – — · booyzen eldest of her four children by matthys roos. his sister married a gert johannes laubeschagne, so the name stands twice on one page.
matthys johannes roos — – — · booyzen named for his father. second of the four roos children on the 1902 notice.

johannes sybert roos — – — · booyzen third of the roos children, and he carries sybert — the same name as his mother's van staden son by her first husband. a name crossing between two marriages of one woman.
anna francisa roos — – — · booyzen her only daughter, and the only one of the six step-children whose marriage the notice records: married in community of property to gert johannes laubeschagne.
gert johannes laubeschagne — – — · booyzen named on the 1902 notice as anna francisa roos's husband, married in community of property. the only son-in-law on the page.

elisabetta johanna sophia myburgh c. 1862 – bef. mar 1935 · booyzen his wife, named with him on their son’s 1882 baptism at rustenburg — an index entry with no image. she is named again, and readably, on the 1935 sterfkennis of their son diederik arnoldus, where both she and ockert are entered oorlede. two sons documented: hendrik stephanus nicolaas, baptised 1882, and diederik arnoldus, born about august 1887.

s: c. Aug 1887, Zwartruggens – 1 Mar 1935, Voorbedacht No. 401, district Rustenburg · Booyzen
q: diederik arnoldus booysen c. aug 1887, zwartruggens – 1 mar 1935, voorbedacht no. 401, district rustenburg · booyzen a karweier — a transport rider — of zwartruggens, and a son of ockert johannes stephanus booysen and elizabeth johanna sophia myburgh. his sterfkennis 87882 is the first document in this archive printed in afrikaans rather than dutch or english, and the first booysen estate here worth more than £300. he married elizabeth anna bronkhorst, widow joubert, in community of property; their youngest son carries his grandfather’s name.

elizabeth anna bronkhorst — – — · booyzen his wife, married in community of property, and a widow before him — her first husband joubert died 31 january 1916, leaving her two children whom somebody at the master’s office marked in pencil as not the deceased’s. she signed the 1935 sterfkennis herself, as nagelate weduwee.

ockert johannes stephanus booysen of 1927 23 oct 1927 – — · booyzen the fourth generation to carry the name that came into this family with anna catharina johanna olivier, whose father was ocken johannes oliefier of the district of cradock. named on his father’s 1935 sterfkennis as a minor of seven.

s: 4 Jan 1882, Rustenburg – 8 Oct 1959, Kempton Park — buried 12 Oct, Roodepoort–Maraisburg · Booyzen
q: hendrik stephanus nicolaas booyen 4 jan 1882, rustenburg – 8 oct 1959, kempton park — buried 12 oct, roodepoort–maraisburg · booyzen baptised at rustenburg on 30 january 1882, son of ockert johannes stephanus booysen and elisabetta johanna sophia myburgh — and named for his uncle, who was then twenty and would be dead at brakfontein before the boy turned ten. he outlived that uncle by sixty-eight years.

anna catharina sophia benadie — – — · booyzen his wife, named with him on two baptisms at rustenburg, in 1889 and 1894. both entries are index-only.

ockert johannes stefanus booysen of 1894 16 may 1894 – — · booyzen baptised at rustenburg on 4 november 1894, son of petrus jakobus booysen and anna catharina sophia benadie — named for his uncle, who was named for his mother’s father, ocken johannes oliefier of the district of cradock. three generations of a name that came into this family with one marriage.
anna maria booijsen — – — · booyzen eighth and last on the 1876 notice, named for her mother anna maria van der merwe.

s: 10 Sep 1824, baptised 4 Oct 1824 at Cradock – 9 May 1891, Brakfontein, district Rustenburg · Booyzen
q: anna catharina johanna olivier 10 sep 1824, baptised 4 oct 1824 at cradock – 9 may 1891, brakfontein, district rustenburg · booyzen the first wife of hendrik stefanus booijsen, and for a week this archive had her filed as a stranger. her own sterfkennis 6332 gives her parents as ocken johannes oliefier and anna johanna botha, her age as 67 years 8 months and 1 day, her farm as brakfontein — which this archive read as boekfontein — and her surname as oliefier, which this archive read as alberts. she was still married when she died: her husband outlived her by seventeen years and remarried at zeerust eleven months later. seven children, all of age: petrus jacobus, ocken johannes, anna johanna maria, elesabettha maria cornelya, alettha catrina johanna, magdalena johanna, hendrick stefanus nicolaas. her father is where ockert johannes came into this family — and her 1824 baptism gives his name entire, ockert johannes stephanus olivier, which is exactly what her son was called. she married hendrik stephanus booijzen at potchefstroom on 3 july 1850, entry 206, she 25 and he 23 — the earliest evidence this archive has of this family north of the vaal, twenty-six years before the 1876 death at rustenburg and two years before the sand river convention.

s: c. 31 Jan 1862, district Rustenburg – 14 May 1891, Brakfontein, district Rustenburg · Booyzen
q: hendrik stefanus nicolaas booijsen c. 31 jan 1862, district rustenburg – 14 may 1891, brakfontein, district rustenburg · booyzen dead at twenty-nine on his father's farm, five days after his mother, and unknown to this archive until his notice was read. sterfkennis 6361: landbouwer, ongehuwd, movables only and not above £25, and line 3 names his parents — hendrick stefanus booijsen and anna catrena gebooren oliefier. he is the seventh child on his mother's list and the first booysen this archive has documented as born in the transvaal.

ockert johannes stephanus olivier — – — · olivier named with his wife anna johanna botha on line 3 of their daughter's 1891 sterfkennis, and the reason a booysen grandson was called ockert johannes stephanus. he is the head of a line this archive has not worked at all.

elesabettha maria cornelya booijsen — – — · booyzen fourth of the seven children on the 1891 sterfkennis. of age by 1891, and absent from her father's 1908 notice, which names only four children — so she probably died in between.

anna maria van der merwe 1785 – bef. mar 1825 · booyzen wikitree makes her a daughter of david schalk van der merwe and anna elizabeth louw—which, if right, is where the forename david schalk entered this family: her eldest son carries her father’s names entire.from wikitree, not from a document this archive has read, and it is checkable against the van der merwe baptism registers rather than the tree. his wife, married 1805 at graaff-reinet — and documented, which she was not until today. a dutch reformed baptism of 4 january 1807 names her as the mother of david schalk booijzen, born 12 december 1806, who is first of the eight children on the 1876 sterfkennis. that resolves a contradiction this archive marked serious (they were married by 1806, so the 1825 cape town marriage record is a different couple) and it rewrites the wall on the ancestor chart, which said only a family tree put her there. what is still not proved is that she is the mother of the 1812 man in the direct line.

s: 30 Apr 1819, Graaff-Reinet – 19 May 1863, Zevenfontein, Brak River · Mountjoy

q: george downing mountjoy booyzen 1 jun 1901, cape province – 11 dec 1947, forest hill — west park, d.r., grave 2171 · booyzen buried west park three days later. boomkweker, then clerk, south african railways. married his first cousin once removed.

david schalk booysen 9 jun 1848, cradock – after nov 1905 · booyzen fourth on the 1863 list, and the direct ancestor's brother — willem hermanus is sixth on the same list. for the whole of this project he was a line on that list and nothing else. his wife's 1900 death notice gives him a household: married elizabetha margaretha marais at lady grey, the same small cape church where his brother married kathleen barry in 1879; eight children; and by 1900 he was at pretoria, living in a zinc building in market street. he signed her notice there in march 1904 — and on 27 november 1905 he married again at pretoria, to johanna elena stols, widow lowies, of skinners court. he was 56, a widower of goede hoop, pretoria, and the register gives his birthplace as cradock. the remarks column cites his remarriage certificate from the master, no. 4795 — which is the number of his first wife’s death notice, so the two documents point at each other and the identification needs no inference. his own death is still not found.

johanna elena stols c. 1854, potchefstroom district – — · booyzen his second wife, married at pretoria on 27 november 1905 — she 51 and a widow lowies of skinners court, he 56 and a widower of goede hoop. her first husband was charles petrus barend lowies, born in the district of cradock about 1849 and dead at pretoria on 5 june 1905 — five months and twenty-two days before she married again. estate 7081, which the marriage register cites beside his 4795. twelve children by lowies, six of them still minors when he died — and her second husband lived at the same address, goedehoop. she signed her first husband’s death notice on 27 october 1905 and married her second on 27 november.

s: c. Oct 1848, district Cradock – 5 Jun 1905, the Lunatic Asylum, Pretoria · Booyzen
q: charles petrus barend lowies c. oct 1848, district cradock – 5 jun 1905, the lunatic asylum, pretoria · booyzen her first husband, and estate 7081 — the other number cited in the remarks column of the 1905 marriage register. born in the district of cradock about 1849, within a year of david schalk booysen and in the same karoo district; dead at pretoria, where david schalk had been widowed five years earlier. his parents were jan lowies and elisabetha maria lubbe, and he left twelve children. the file is now read. he was a hawker, of goedehoop, pretoria — which is the exact address david schalk booyzen gave on the marriage register three weeks later, so the two men lived in the same place. dutch, of the cradock district, 56 years and 8 months, dead in the lunatic asylum at pretoria on 5 june 1905. movables but no land, an estate over £100, and a will. six of the twelve children were still minors. his widow signed the notice on 27 october and married david schalk on 27 november.

q: elizabetha margaretha marais c. apr 1850, district cradock – 1 jun 1900, market street, pretoria · booyzen his wife, married at lady grey near aliwal north. daughter of stephanus francois marais and elizabetha margaretha marais, born in the district of cradock about april 1850. she died in a zinc building in market street, pretoria on 1 june 1900 — four days before lord roberts entered the town — and her husband did not file the notice for three years and nine months. nothing movable left, and a compensation claim filed.

john augustus barry i 1819, “at sea (exact whereabouts unknown), british” – 1903 · barry his 1915 death notice types the birthplace as at sea and his mother as “born neagle”. cape mounted rifles.

s: 1826 – 2 Aug 1912, Manorowen, Barkly East — estate 1291 · Kolbe
q: margaretha wilhelmina elizabeth mary kolbe 1826 – 2 aug 1912, manorowen, barkly east — estate 1291 · kolbe his wife, married 1846. daughter of the 1820 settler — and the reason the kolbe name runs through the booyzens. her own death notice 1291, filed by her son r. p. barry at barkly east in may 1915, three years after she died, gives her age as 84, her nationality as afrikander of european extraction, her father as “kolbe, thinks james was christian name” and her mother as unknown. she died in r. p. barry’s house at manorowen and left nothing — no movable property, no immovable, estate nil, no will. and she names nine children where her husband’s notice names eight. the ninth is william.
hendrik nicholaas barry — – — · barry married anna johanna maria schoeman. the second barry–schoeman link.
margarietha wilhelmina elizabeth barry 1880 – 1961 · barry her 1961 pension is ordinary, not military — the archive checked.

dorothea regina barry — – — · barry named on the 1915 death notice. a niece of the same name was baptised at slang river on 3 april 1892 — daughter of her brother hendrik nicholaas and anna johanna maria schoeman — so the two have to be kept apart.

t: Dorothea Regina Barry of Slang River
q: dorothea regina barry of slang river 11 jan 1892 – — · barry baptised at slang river, 3 april 1892, daughter of hendrik nicholaas barry and anna johanna maria schoeman — and named for her aunt. from the index.

ruben jacobus hosea barry 7 oct 1888 – — · barry baptised at dordrecht, 25 november 1888, son of hendrik nicholaas barry and anna johanna maria schoeman — and named for his uncle ruben jacobus josuah. the schoeman name ruben, given twice in two generations. from the index.
ellen hendrika barry 8 dec 1899 – — · barry baptised 6 june 1900, daughter of hendrik nicholaas barry and anna johanna maria schoeman. from the index.
jeannie maria catharina botha — – — · barry richard pieter barry's wife, named on their son's 1898 baptism at barkly west.

james henry barry c. 1847 – 23 jun 1939, barkly east · barry named on the 1915 death notice, which he swore himself. the index now dates him: born about 1847, dead at barkly east on 23 june 1939, having outlived his father by thirty-six years. but that year cannot stand. his brother john augustus barry ii was born 13 march 1847 off a register, and “about 1847” here is not a date at all — it is an age worked back from the 1939 death. two brothers cannot share it. a relationship search on his mother's surname turned up a henry jaonas barry born 13 july 1848 and baptised at twenty, which is where a next child belongs; whether that is this man under a clerk's ear is unproved and the register is unread.

richard peter barry — – — · barry kathleen's brother. signed his mother's 1915 death notice as "son in whose house deceased died", at manorowen, barkly east. a richard peter barry, plaasboer of jerpoint, is on the cape rebel roll — same name, right region, identity not proven.

richard pieter kolbe barry 1899 – — · barry carries both names at once — richard pieter, for the barry of manorowen, and kolbe, for the 1820 settler family his great-grandmother married out of. married maria magdalena siebert. from the index; no image read.

harriet louisa barry 1894 – 7 sep 1912, barkly east · barry of manorowen, barkly east district — the farm where richard peter barry signed his mother’s death notice in 1915. dead at eighteen. from the index.
john gerson eliazer barry 1893 – 8 mar 1941, barkly east · barry married elizabeth johanna magdalena botha. from the index.

s: 1895, Barkly East – 11 Jul 1963, East London · Barry
q: theunis christoffel barry 1895, barkly east – 11 jul 1963, east london · barry from the index.
cornelia herculena petronella barry — – 21 dec 1909, cherryville, barkly east · barry of cherryville, barkly east — a third named barry farm, after manorowen and jerpoint. from the index.

johanna catharina mountjoy of indwe — – jun 1911, indwe · mountjoy she joined the dutch reformed congregation at indwe on 23 july 1907, arriving from barkly oost — six weeks after willem hermanus booijzen was confirmed in the same church — and the register’s last column records her dead there in june 1911. a mountjoy and a booyzen in one small colliery congregation, twenty-two years after the two families stood at the same font at barkly oost.

william henry keys 1854 – — · mountjoy married johanna catharina mountjoy, baptised at burgersdorp on 29 february 1860 — a daughter of george mountjoy and maria sophia botha, which this archive had been asking about and can now answer. eight children baptised across dordrecht, barkly east and barkly west between 1878 and 1898: robert byron, william henry, james jonathan, george, lancelott byron, cecil frederik, rachel anna maria and herklaas edward johannes. the mountjoy forenames crossing into a third surname, exactly as the barry names crossed into the daschners — and byron twice, which appears nowhere else in this archive.

s: 28 Jan 1860, baptised 29 Feb 1860 at Burgersdorp – — · Mountjoy
q: johanna catharina mountjoy of burgersdorp 28 jan 1860, baptised 29 feb 1860 at burgersdorp – — · mountjoy a daughter of george mountjoy and maria sophia botha, baptised on a leap day, and the woman who married william henry keys. this archive has carried “a johanna catharina mountjoy” married to keys since the index was read and could not say which one. this one.

anna catharina mountjoy 5 aug 1852, baptised 11 jan 1854 – — · mountjoy eldest of the eight children of george mountjoy and maria sophia botha this archive can name, out of the thirteen their marriage certificate says they had.
maria elizabeth mountjoy 12 jun 1858, baptised at graaff-reinet – — · mountjoy baptised two days after she was born, at graaff-reinet — which is where this family keeps turning up.

george herkules johannes mountjoy 16 jan 1862, baptised at smithfield – — · mountjoy baptised 27 april 1862 at smithfield in the orange free state — the family had crossed the border. he carries his father's name and his brother's.
elsje petronella frederika mountjoy 10 jun 1864, baptised at smithfield – — · mountjoy baptised 17 july 1864 at smithfield, orange free state. elsje appears nowhere else in this archive.
jacoba regina mountjoy 14 jun 1868, baptised 15 aug 1868 – — · mountjoy named for her aunt jacoba catharina mountjoy, who married david schalk van der merwe at cradock in 1838 and died in 1842.

robert byron keys 3 jan 1878, baptised 26 jan 1878 – — · mountjoy eldest of the eight keys children. byron is a name that appears nowhere else in this archive, and it appears twice among these children — it comes in from the keys side, not the mountjoy.

s: 10 Jun 1882, baptised 23 Jul 1882 at Dordrecht – — · Mountjoy
q: william henry keys the younger 10 jun 1882, baptised 23 jul 1882 at dordrecht – — · mountjoy named for his father. second of the eight.

s: 5 Jan 1884, baptised 21 Feb 1886 at Dordrecht – — · Mountjoy
q: george keys 5 jan 1884, baptised 21 feb 1886 at dordrecht – — · mountjoy named for his mother's father, george mountjoy the saddler of cradock — and baptised two years after he was born, which this family did more than once.

s: 29 Jan 1888, baptised 4 Mar 1888 at Dordrecht – — · Mountjoy
q: lancelott byron keys 29 jan 1888, baptised 4 mar 1888 at dordrecht – — · mountjoy the second byron. lancelott and byron in one name, in a dordrecht font, in 1888.

s: 15 Sep 1891, baptised 8 Nov 1891 at Barkly East – — · Mountjoy
q: cecil frederik keys 15 sep 1891, baptised 8 nov 1891 at barkly east – — · mountjoy baptised at barkly east — the family had moved from dordrecht by 1891. a cecil frederick keys turns up later in the transvaal probate index, unread.

s: 5 May 1895, baptised 14 Jul 1895 at Barkly East – — · Mountjoy
q: rachel anna maria keys 5 may 1895, baptised 14 jul 1895 at barkly east – — · mountjoy the only daughter among the eight. rachel is rare here — the archive has met it once before, in rachel margaretha williamse, born booijzen, on a 1900 death notice at pretoria.
james jonathan keys 18 nov 1883 – — · mountjoy baptised at dordrecht, 2 december 1883, and named for james jonathan mountjoy. from the index.
herklaas edward johannes keys 9 feb 1897 – — · mountjoy barkly west, and named for herklaas — hercules johannes mountjoy. from the index.

fred j. barry — – — · barry cape rebel, plaasboer of ivanhoe, district barkly east / wodehouse, tried june 1901 — the same month as schoeman of caerlaverock. relationship to this family unproven; the middle initial does not match frederick fortunatus.

ruben jacobus josuah barry — – — · barry withdrawn as a son, for the same reason as dorothea regina: the 1915 death notice, read entire, does not name him. the register holds a ruben jacobus hosea baptised at dordrecht in 1888, a grandson. the schoeman name ruben does come into this family — one generation later than this archive said.

s: 10 Nov 1863, baptised 10 Jul 1864 at Dordrecht – — · Barry
q: frederick fortunatus barry 10 nov 1863, baptised 10 jul 1864 at dordrecht – — · barry carries the kolbe given name fortunatus.
john kolbe — – — · kolbe godfather at the burgersdorp font on 23 october 1853, standing for his sister margaretha's son william fredrik barry. a brother this archive did not have.
george kolbe — – — · kolbe godfather at the same font, the same day. he carries his own father's name — george augustus kolbe, the 1820 settler, dead at colesberg nine years earlier.

catharine kolbe — – — · kolbe godmother two entries above, at the baptism of her sister mary elizabeth's son augustus kolbe enslin. three kolbe siblings stand at two fonts on one afternoon at burgersdorp.

george frederick enslin — – — · kolbe married mary elizabeth kolbe, not margaretha — and this archive took weeks and two documents to be sure of it. named as the father on the burgersdorp baptism of 23 october 1853, two entries above his sister-in-law's child.

mary elizabeth kolbe — – bef. 1867 · kolbe margaretha's sister, and the woman who married george frederick enslin — which is the whole answer to a contradiction this archive carried as serious, that margaretha appeared to marry enslin while married to john barry. it was resolved from margaret downing's 1867 death notice. the burgersdorp register of 23 october 1853 shows it instead: the two sisters baptising a son each, two entries apart, on one page.

s: 7 Sep 1853, baptised 23 Oct 1853 at Burgersdorp – — · Kolbe
q: augustus kolbe enslin 7 sep 1853, baptised 23 oct 1853 at burgersdorp – — · kolbe her son, baptised on the same afternoon as his cousin william fredrik barry. entered in the register as augustus kolbe, with the enslin left off the child's own line entirely.

t: Anna van der Merwe of Burgersdorp
q: anna van der merwe of burgersdorp — – — · kolbe the third godparent at the 1853 barry font, and the only one who is not a kolbe. a van der merwe standing at a barry christening at burgersdorp — a surname this archive has been chasing on the entirely other side of the family, among the booysens of graaff-reinet. not connected, and set down so the coincidence is on the record.

s: 23 Aug 1853, baptised 23 Oct 1853 at Burgersdorp – — · Barry
q: william barry 23 aug 1853, baptised 23 oct 1853 at burgersdorp – — · barry found twice in one day. he came in on the 1915 death notice of his mother margaretha kolbe, estate 1291, which names nine children where his father's names eight — and then the burgersdorp doopregister produced his baptism: william fredrik, born 23 august 1853, christened 23 october, godparents john kolbe, anna van der merwe and george kolbe. two of the three are his mother's brothers. a second william frederick thomas was baptised in 1861 and this archive cannot say whether the first died or a clerk erred — a doubt re-surfaced, and briefly mistaken for a new find, when the index was asked for every barry child of a kolbe mother. he is not on his father's notice, not on the cape rebel roll, and nowhere else in this archive. his father's 1903 registration said eleven children; with william there are nine named and two still missing.
kathleen mary barry — – — · barry named on the 1915 death notice.

john augustus barry ii 13 mar 1847, baptised 12 apr 1847 – — · barry the eldest son on the 1915 notice, carrying his father's name exactly — which is why this archive calls the father john augustus barry i. his own documents call him simply john barry, and that is the third man in this family the name has to be shared out between. his birth date does one more job than it looks: being hard, off a register, it is what forces his brother james henry's “about 1847” to move.

s: 26 Apr 1850, baptised 9 Jun 1850 at Graaff-Reinet – — · Barry
q: george augustus barry 26 apr 1850, baptised 9 jun 1850 at graaff-reinet – — · barry new. named on his father's 1915 death notice and nowhere else this archive has looked. he carries his grandfather george augustus kolbe's names entire.

margaret mary bedford — – — · barry born barry, and on the 1915 notice as married to tom bedford. the tree carries a margaretha louisa maria who married thomas bedford in 1875; the notice gives her as margaret mary, and the archive has not reconciled the two.

johan gottlieb kolbe 1765 – 1845 · kolbe tailor. died at 34 conduit street, mayfair — not lamb's conduit street; the tree's photograph is of the wrong building. buried at the german savoy church, strand.

george augustus kolbe 1802 – 1 dec 1844, “wurtemburg”, colesberg · kolbe 1820 settler — the nautilus, owen's party, algoa bay 14 apr 1820. married at sixteen on a sworn falsehood. preached across the orange river. his grandson could not name him in 1915.
margaret downing c. 1804, london – — · downing married at fifteen in shoreditch, signing with a mark. died owning a house and a farm.
john paul downing — – — · downing margaret's father.
john gottlob kolbe — – — · kolbe of the london kolbes.
marian kolbe — – — · kolbe of the london kolbes.
julia kolbe — – — · kolbe one of the five kolbe children whose death records are not yet read.
frederik fortunatus kolbe — – — · kolbe the source of the fortunatus name across three families.
peter benjamin kolbe — – — · kolbe of the kolbe children.
petrus jacobus pretorius — – — · pretorius anna's father. gave consent to her marriage at eighteen.
anna johanna maria schoeman — – — · schoeman the schoeman who married into the barrys — and the reason the 1924 marriage was between cousins.
dirk jacobus pretorius — – — · pretorius of the pretorius family.
isaak pretorius — – — · pretorius of the pretorius family.
ruben schoeman — – — · schoeman of barkly oost. father of anna johanna maria schoeman.
magdalena johanna botha — – — · schoeman ruben schoeman's wife.
daniel willem schoeman — – — · schoeman plaasboer of caerlaverock, tried as a cape rebel in june 1901 — the month before the family married in his house, where he signed the register.

tersia booyzen living – — · testimony recorded the name-change and anglo-boer war account on the myheritage tree, as told to her by her father. it is family testimony and not from a document — which is exactly why this archive quotes it in full and then tests it against the cape rebel rolls and the surname distribution, rather than repeating it.

graaff-reinet town, cape colony · karoo where this family is oldest. johanna catharina montjoy was born here on 30 april 1819 and james montjoy married anna catharina slier here on 9 march 1817. the dutch reformed baptism registers here carry the family from 1788 to 1857.

cradock town, cape colony · karoo a saddler's town, and the top of the mountjoy line. james montjoy died here in september 1827 owning a house and erf worth £90; his son george learned his trade here and married here in 1848.

achter sneeuwberg farming district · karoo “behind the sneeuberg.” the place column of the 1851 baptism register, which tells us the family was farming out beyond the mountain rather than living in cradock town.

s: Farm · Brak River, later Middelburg district
q: zevenfontein farm · brak river, later middelburg district the family farm across two death notices twenty-one years apart — and the district boundary moved under it. johanna catharina died here in 1863 when it was reckoned brak river, port elizabeth; her husband died here in 1884 when it was middelburg.

barkly east town and district · north-eastern cape the district the family belongs to for two generations, and the most rebellious corner of the colony in 1899–1902. its doop register holds the booyzen and mountjoy baptisms on facing pages. it is also the only place in this archive where an estate is itemised: a retired builder's savings-bank deposit, a house on lot 380 let at fifty shillings a month, and a village's worth of unpaid accounts — two butchers, a doctor and a burial society.

manorowen farm · barkly east the barry farm, and now documented as john barry's own house rather than only his son's. the 1903 registration of his death gives his residence and his place of death as manor owen, ward iv, with his son richard barry living at the same address and signing as “son present at death”. margaretha kolbe died here in 1915. harriet louisa barry, eighteen, lived here and was buried here in 1912. three deaths in this family on one farm in twelve years.

jerpoint farm · cape colony named for an abbey in county kilkenny — the first irish place name this archive has found anywhere near the barrys, whose irish origin it has never been able to place. a richard peter barry, plaasboer of jerpoint, is on the cape rebel roll.
ivanhoe farm · barkly east / wodehouse fred j. barry farmed here and was tried as a cape rebel in june 1901 — the same district and the same month as schoeman of caerlaverock.

caerlaverock farm · wodehouse / barkly east named for a castle in dumfriesshire. the family married in this house in july 1901 — five weeks after its owner, daniel willem schoeman, was tried as a cape rebel. he signed the register.

dordrecht town · wodehouse where this side of the family married, and where its in-laws lived. hercules johannes mountjoy married maria sophia van niekerk here on 8 october 1888, aged 22 — a year before the 1889 font at barkly oost. james john mountjoy and maria louisa bertha kumm gave dordrecht as their place of last marriage too, on two death notices filed at barkly east fifty years later. and it is where maria sophia’s mother died, at her own house, in december 1902.

indwe colliery town · north-eastern cape a colliery town, and this archive took three passes to notice that the word matters. willem hermanus booyzen died at doorn street, indwe, on 13 september 1905 of an ulcer of the stomach. his daughter catharina maria sophia married joseph heinrich daschner here. and his son — a son this archive did not know it had — was confirmed here in 1907 at twenty-one, married here in 1908 as a mijnwerker of dugmore mijn, and had two children baptised here in 1908 and 1910, both entered onecht. their grandmother kathleen barry stood godmother at the first font, three years after she was widowed in this town. indwe is where the family testimony's last line turns out to be true, in the wrong province.

lady grey town · north-eastern cape he is entered as a boer — farmer — of lady grey at his marriage in 1879, and a mason at his death in 1905. something took the land away in between, and the 1884 estate says it may already have been gone.
wodehouse district · north-eastern cape hercules johannes mountjoy died here on 12 may 1941, aged 74 — and the cape town archives hold no estate file for him under any spelling.

colesberg town · northern cape midlands george augustus kolbe, the 1820 settler, died on the farm “wurtemburg” in this district on 1 december 1844. his widow signed the death notice here in january 1845, and the 1840 montjoy notice was signed here too.

burgersdorp town · north-eastern cape george augustus kolbe and margaret downing lie under a cut-stone monument in the old cemetery here — names, london birthplaces, farm and dates carved on it, about forty miles from where their grandson wrote that he could not name them.
johannesburg city · witwatersrand where the family arrives with nothing and where the archive's starting point was born. forest hill, mayfair, fordsburg and germiston all appear on its certificates.
west park cemetery cemetery · johannesburg anna pretorius was buried here in 1944 and her husband three years later, three days after he died.
brixton cemetery cemetery · johannesburg kathleen barry's intended place of burial on her 1940 death form — a mile and a half from the mayfair house, and a long way from barkly east.
vereeniging town · transvaal where george downing mountjoy booyzen married anna johanna maria pretorius on 30 december 1924 — she aged eighteen, with her father's written consent.

rustenburg town · transvaal where the male line's oldest documented man died. petrus jacobus booysen, born at graaff-reinet about 1788, died in this district on 1 september 1876, eighty-eight years old, a widower, with nothing to leave — "niets nagelaten. niets bekend." his sterfkennis was written at the farm brakfontein on 14 september and signed by his son hendrik stefanus. it is the single most important place on this map, because it destroys the idea that this family reached the transvaal by railway in the twentieth century.
soho, london parish · middlesex st anne's, soho, where george augustus kolbe was baptised on 2 february 1803, son of john gottlob and mary. the register notes 410 baptisms for the year 1802.

shoreditch parish · london st leonard's, where george augustus kolbe married margaret downing in 1819 on a sworn falsehood — both swore they were twenty-one; he was sixteen and she fifteen. she signed with a mark.

conduit street street · mayfair, london 34 conduit street, where johan gottlieb kolbe the tailor died in 1845 — not lamb's conduit street, which is where the family tree put him and where its photograph shows the wrong building.

german savoy church church · strand, london where johan gottlieb kolbe was actually buried on 26 november 1845, entry 55, grave 7 — not st john the baptist, leamington, warwickshire, as the tree has it. the correction makes the family more coherent, not less: they are german lutherans of the savoy.

heilbron town · orange free state where the only booysen in the whole joiners register comes from — j. j. booysen, four hundred miles from barkly east and in a different country at the time. it matters because the family's account of the name change rests on there having been booysen joiners.

middelburg town and district · cape colony zevenfontein fell in this district by 1884. and a p. j. booyzen — spelled with the z — was a police constable at the middelburg police office in 1904, 1905 and 1907, with mortgage bonds in 1904 and 1906. not shown to be a relative.

stutterheim town · eastern cape ferdinand kumm died here on 20 october 1903 — and his death notice is the document an external source mistook for james jonathan mountjoy's. the town returned to this archive from a different direction entirely: joseph heinrich daschner, who married a booyzen daughter at indwe, was born here about november 1883.

brisbane city · queensland, australia where the line reaches now. the sixteen booyzens recorded in australia are likely a separate migration; this family arrived through the lerena and defranceski marriages rather than under the booyzen name.

pretoria city · transvaal where the transvaal master of the supreme court sat, and so where this family's later estates were filed — the depot this archive spent its whole life not searching. stephanus francois booyzen died at east lynne, on its eastern edge, in 1940.

marico district · western transvaal a substantial booyzen farming district — and this archive can no longer say whose. seven booyzen claims for compensation as burghers were filed here in 1903–04, and the booyzen children who died in the johannesburg and vereeniging camps came from farms in this district. this entry used to call them "emphatically someone else's". that judgement rested on the belief that this family was in the cape until about 1907 — and the 1876 sterfkennis at rustenburg, one district east, shows it was not. no document links this family to any of the seven claims. no document rules it out either. unresolved is the honest word. 13 september 2026: and now a documented booysen marriage in the district. hendrik stephanus booysen — seventh child on the 1876 sterfkennis, son of the direct ancestor — married charlotta elizabetha dormehl at zeerust, the principal town of marico. it still links this family to none of the seven compensation claims. it does mean the last of the three districts has had one of these people standing in it, and the sentence this archive withdrew was wronger than it knew.
mossel bay town · southern cape where stephanus francois booyzen married beatrix magdalena catharina boshoff — six hundred miles from where he was born and eight hundred from where he died.
potchefstroom town · transvaal a booyzen presence from at least 1860, when jan booyzen paid his marriage fee to the government here. whether the line connects to this family is unproven.

booysens suburb, johannesburg · witwatersrand not a family place — a trap. booysens is a mining suburb south of the johannesburg city centre, a couple of miles from forest hill and kenilworth where this family actually lived in the 1940s. it means every name-index search for booysen in johannesburg returns people whose only connection to the word is an address. the archive met it head-on: a death notice indexed under the surname daschner turned out to belong to charles bruce rennie, a miner of booysens, and nothing else about him touches this family at all.

brakfontein farm · district rustenburg, transvaal the farm where the oldest document in this archive was written. on 14 september 1876, thirteen days after the death, somebody at brakfontein filled in sterfkennis no. 678 for petrus jacobus booijsen, aged 88, and wrote the names of his parents on line 3. fifteen years later it takes two more: his son's wife on 9 may 1891 and their son five days after her. and in 1892 hendrik stefanus, marrying again at zeerust, still gives brakfontein as his home — sixteen years on the same ground. the coordinates are approximate: the district is certain, the farm is not yet placed.

lichtenburg district · western transvaal where this family's western transvaal branch is, and it is a branch rather than a lead now. jan gerthardus lodewikus booijsen — fifth of the eight children on the 1876 sterfkennis, born district graaff-reinet about 1818 — died on the farm vaalbank in this district on 25 may 1885, estate tab mhg o/2899. his daughter magdalena susanna maria died on the same farm on 1 may 1920, and her sterfkennis names him. lichtenburg is one district west of rustenburg, where his father died in 1876, and one district east of marico.

dugmore mine colliery · indwe, district wodehouse where a booyzen worked underground. the indwe marriage register of 21 september 1908 gives both bride and groom's dwelling place as “dugmore mijn” and the groom's trade as “mijnwerker”. it is the only mine anywhere in this archive attached to a named member of this family, and it is coal in the cape rather than gold on the rand. the coordinates are approximate — the workings were at indwe and the exact site is not yet fixed.

vaalbank farm · district lichtenburg, transvaal one farm, two deaths, thirty-five years apart, and the same family on it both times. jan gerthardus lodewikus booijsen — born district graaff-reinet about 1818, fifth child on the 1876 sterfkennis — died here on 25 may 1885. his daughter magdalena susanna maria, born about 1860, died here on 1 may 1920. it is the clearest evidence this archive has that the family did not merely pass through the western transvaal but settled in it, two generations before anyone reached johannesburg. the coordinates are approximate: the district is certain, the farm is not yet placed.

cherryville farm · district barkly east the third named barry farm, after manorowen and jerpoint. harriet louisa barry, eighteen, died here of typhoid on 7 september 1912 after thirty days' illness and was carried back to manorowen to be buried. her father, who signed the form, gave his own residence as manorowen — so cherryville is somewhere the family worked rather than lived, or another barry household entirely. the coordinates are approximate.

slang river locality · north-eastern cape where dorothea regina barry, daughter of hendrik nicholaas barry and anna johanna maria schoeman, was baptised on 3 april 1892. from the index rather than the register, and placed only approximately.

koedoesfontein farm · district rustenburg, transvaal where hendrik stephanus booysen died on 11 may 1908, aged seventy-nine, in the house of his son-in-law willem grobelaar. a farmer with no movable property, some land, and mutual wills with both of his dead wives. thirty-two years earlier he had signed his own father's sterfkennis at brakfontein, one district over. the coordinates are approximate.

zeerust town, district marico · transvaal the principal town of marico, and the district this archive spent weeks holding at arm's length with the sentence “they are not this family, who were cape”. hendrik stefanus booijzen married here on 14 april 1892 — 63, a widower of brakfontein — and signed his second wife's death notice here in august 1902. the sentence is withdrawn.

s: Farm, Groot Marico · District Marico, Transvaal
q: driefontein farm, groot marico · district marico, transvaal charlotta elizabeth dormehl's own place. she gave it as her home when she married at zeerust in april 1892, and she died there on 6 february 1902 — three months before the peace, and ten years into a marriage to a man who farmed a hundred miles away at brakfontein. she never moved to him. the coordinates are approximate: the district is certain, the farm is not placed.

zwartruggens town · transvaal where diederik arnoldus booysen was born about august 1887 and lived as a karweier — a transport rider. his 1935 sterfkennis is the first document in this archive printed in afrikaans rather than dutch or english, and it names his parents: ockert johannes stephanus booysen and elizabeth johanna sophia myburgh, both by then dead.

voorbedacht no. 401 farm · district rustenburg, transvaal where diederik arnoldus booysen died on 1 march 1935, aged 47 years 7 months, with an estate over £300 and a will — the largest booysen estate this archive has read. a numbered farm, which is how the transvaal registered land. coordinates approximate.

klerksdorp town · transvaal where ockert johannes stephanus booysen died on 16 january 1921, aged 69 — the man who signed his father's death notice in 1908 and who carried his mother's father's name out of the district of cradock and into the western transvaal. it is a civil registration and it names no parents, which is why this archive keeps going back to sterfkennisse. he has no estate file of his own.

market street, pretoria street · pretoria, transvaal elizabetha margaretha booijzen, born marais, died in a zinc building in market street on 1 june 1900 — the capital's main street, four days before lord roberts entered the town. her husband david schalk booijzen, the direct ancestor's brother, did not file her death notice for three years and nine months, and against the question about movable property he wrote “none. compensation claim filed.”

turffontein suburb · johannesburg, transvaal 18 anderson street. richard peter booyzen, twenty-four, married, a sawyer, died here of influenza and pneumonia on 25 october 1918 after eleven days — the centre of black october, which killed some fourteen thousand people on the rand in six weeks. he was buried at brixton two days later. his birthplace on the form is the cape of good hope: born in the north-eastern cape, dead in a johannesburg mining suburb at twenty-four.

mayfair suburb · johannesburg, transvaal this archive has had mayfair as a word on two pages and never as an address. kathleen barry died here in 1940. her great-granddaughter catherine mary sophia booyzen was married at st joseph's, mayfair on 15 january 1949 — the hinge into the lerena archive. and her son henry james booyzen was living at 3 15th avenue when he died in 1956. three generations in one suburb, and the cemetery register is what finally gave it a street number.

roodepoort town · west rand, transvaal hendrik stephanus nicolaas booysen — baptised at rustenburg in 1882, dead at kempton park in 1959 — was buried in the central cemetery of the municipality of roodepoort–maraisburg on 12 october 1959, section i d.r., entry 96. this archive published him as buried at johannesburg for an afternoon because the familysearch collection carries that title for every register inside it.

goedehoop place · pretoria, transvaal two men of this story lived here. charles petrus barend lowies, a hawker born in the district of cradock about october 1848, is “of goedehoop, pretoria” on his 1905 death notice — he died in the pretoria lunatic asylum on 5 june that year, leaving twelve children, six still minors. and david schalk booijzen, born in the district of cradock in june 1848, gives goede hoop, pretoria as his home on the register when he marries lowies's widow on 27 november, five months and twenty-two days later. this archive read that register first and wrote the address down without knowing what it meant. coordinates approximate.
